headlines.title: Shares Continue Decline as Lehman Looks for Buyer
headlines.abstract: As confidence in Lehman continued to drain away, the bank, one of the oldest names on Wall Street, continued to reach out to potential buyers, including Bank of America and Barclays.

headlines.title: Lehman Files for Bankruptcy; Merrill Is Sold
headlines.abstract: Lehman Brothers filed for bankruptcy protection, while Merrill Lynch agreed to sell itself to Bank of America.
